workstreams.name: Process area requirements
workstreams.answers: What must the ERP do for finance, purchasing and inventory in the pharmacies and warehouses?
activities: Interview the people who run each process area
Map finance and purchasing together, then inventory
Consolidate the requirements for sign-off

workstreams.name: Current systems fit-gap
workstreams.answers: Where do today's finance, purchasing and inventory systems fall short of those requirements?
activities: Walk through today's systems with the people who use them
Review system documents and operational data
Compare each requirement with what today's systems do

workstreams.name: ERP vendor scoring
workstreams.answers: Which ERP vendors fit the signed-off requirements, and how do they score against them?
activities: Shortlist ERP vendors against the signed-off requirements
Run vendor demonstrations with process owners
Score each vendor against the requirements

workstreams.name: ERP business case
workstreams.answers: Does the business case for the best-fitting vendor support selecting it?
activities: Estimate costs and benefits of the best-fitting vendor
Check cost assumptions against operational data
Set out the case for the selection decision

workstreams.name: ERP configuration
workstreams.answers: Can the chosen ERP be configured and tested for finance, purchasing and inventory?
activities: Configure finance and purchasing together
Configure inventory once the first two areas are tested
Test each area with the people who run the process

workstreams.name: Data migration
workstreams.answers: Can data from today's systems be migrated and loaded into the ERP in a rehearsal?
activities: Map data from today's systems to the ERP
Clean and load data, finance and purchasing first
Run a migration rehearsal and check the results

workstreams.name: Pilot site go-live
workstreams.answers: Does the ERP run live and stable at a pilot site?
activities: Launch the ERP at a pilot site after the readiness review
Track stability with the site's staff and operational data
Log and fix issues before the rollout decision

workstreams.name: Site rollout waves
workstreams.answers: Can the ERP go live in all 40 pharmacies and both warehouses, wave by wave?
activities: Roll out the ERP wave by wave to pharmacies and warehouses
Support each wave until it is stable
Confirm the ERP runs in all pharmacies and warehouses
